candidates.description: This feature activates on terms related to historical colonialism, early American history, and related lexical roots starting with "col" or "imper".
This vector represents historical and prominent English-colonial or early American city and place names.
The tokens represent US states and Canadian provinces.
This vector represents Spanish adverbial suffixes and common adverbial modifiers.
This feature vector activates common Spanish infinitive verbs.
This vector activates for tokens containing or related to the phonetic or orthographic root "ben" across various words and proper names.
This vector represents modal verbs and auxiliary concepts related to possibility, obligation, and capability in Spanish and English.
This vector represents Spanish words and roots containing the common prefix or stem "qu".
This feature vector represents common morphological roots, suffixes, and character combinations found frequently in Romance and Germanic languages.
This feature vector represents word roots and prefixes related to continuation, completion, and large or combined quantities across multiple languages.
